text: Some spirits in [the March](the_march) leave more than a wound. Every hit from an **elite**, and every hit from any spirit **at night**, has a one in four chance to leave you with **Spirit Sickness**.

It stacks up to **level III**. Every level takes **one heart** off your maximum health and slows you a little, and it lasts **5 minutes**, renewed by every fresh hit. You feel it settle in: the game tells you when it takes hold.

pages.title: Lifting it
text: Milk does nothing. Only the old ways work:
- the [Healer's Rattle](healers_rattle) from Bound, a level every shake;
- a wash in a **Spirit Well** in the March: sneak in its water, for **40 Pulse** from a cell you carry.

pages.title: Spirit Blessing
text: The circle and the lodge also leave you with **Spirit Blessing**: **2 extra hearts** and, while it lasts, the sickness cannot take hold at all. Go into the March blessed and the night spirits can only hurt you, not sicken you.
